services.desc: LET’S GO SAILING! is Burlington’s premier charter sailing experience. Captain Gideon’s hospitality and attention to detail is what makes Let’s Go Sailing so memorable. Enjoy a unique and enjoyable experience on Lake Champlain. You’ll see the city of Burlington from a whole new perspective along with Vermont’s Green Mountains and Adirondacks of New York. This backdrop is a photographer’s dream! Corporate outings, a sail with family and friends, bachelorette or birthday parties are all great ideas to sail Lake Champlain on a private boat charter.
